title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: We are thrilled to announce the official launch of Spyglass, making our innovative new tool available to all users.

title: Master Your Files in the Editor
summary: Gain complete control over your embedded files with new management tools, versatile display options, and seamless uploading capabilities right within the editor.

title: Introducing Our Public Product Roadmap
summary: Explore our new Public Product Roadmap to track recently shipped features, discover what's coming next, and preview our exciting future plans.

title: Seamless Checkbox Interactions
summary: Enjoy a smoother workflow with our newly enhanced checkboxes, now bigger, easier to click, and seamlessly draggable for effortless task management.

title: Enhanced Collaboration in the Editor
summary: Enjoy a more seamless and intuitive experience when collaborating with your team, with clearer indications of real-time activity.

title: Seamless Shared Item Discovery
summary: Effortlessly explore and collaborate on shared ideas and quests with improved search and visibility for all your shared items.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Experience Noeko in your preferred language as we roll out robust support for a diverse range of international languages.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: Noeko is now fully open source, empowering our community with unprecedented control, fostering direct involvement, and ensuring complete transparency in our shared journey forward.

title: Smart Knowledge Graph & Collaboration
summary: Navigate and organize your entire knowledge base with unprecedented clarity through our enhanced Graph View, now featuring intuitive filtering by tags, time, and shared items to supercharge your exploration and collaboration.

title: Dynamic Search and Custom Collections
summary: Effortlessly find and organize your knowledge with powerful new filtering and sorting options, enabling you to save specific search configurations as custom collections for quick access.

title: Dynamic Content Views
summary: We're rolling out dynamic new ways to embed and interact with linked content, creating a more intuitive and flexible note-taking experience.

title: Noeko Official Launch: Flexible Hosting and Plans
summary: We're thrilled to officially launch Noeko, offering both a free self-hosted community edition and comprehensive paid plans, providing the flexibility to host Noeko on your own servers or in the cloud.

title: Discover a World of Beautiful New Themes
summary: Get ready to customize your workspace like never before with beautifully polished existing themes and a vibrant collection of brand new visual styles.

title: Personalized Time-of-Day Greetings
summary: Enjoy a more personalized welcome as your greetings will now accurately reflect the exact time of day, enhancing your daily experience.

title: Streamlined Tag Management
summary: Effortlessly manage your tagged content by directly removing items or performing other essential actions from any list view, streamlining your organization process.

title: Connect More of Your Content
summary: Now you can effortlessly bring your favorite YouTube videos, essential websites, and plain text files directly into your workspace for comprehensive analysis and organization.
